name: Fathom
auth_type: API Key (Bearer) for REST API; Personal Access Token (PAT) for MCP
credential_access: Self-serve API key in User Settings → API Access; organization permission may apply for PAT
winner: Gemini closer on API; both missed vendor-hosted MCP (api.fathom.ai/mcp)
evidence_notes: Official Fathom docs & Help Centre confirm vendor-hosted MCP at api.fathom.ai/mcp. REST API uses Bearer API Key.

name: Pumble
auth_type: API Key (ApiKey header) / Workspace App Token for MCP
credential_access: API Key Add-on installed via workspace Configure Apps; Pumble MCP Server configured via Workspace Settings → Apps
winner: Both AI failed MCP (Pumble officially launched native Pumble MCP Server)
evidence_notes: Official Pumble Help Center documents native Pumble MCP Server at how-to-use-the-pumble-mcp-server, with 4-step setup via Create App for AI agents.

name: Grain
credential_access: PAT: self-serve via Integrations page. WAT: workspace admins only (plan-restricted). OAuth: registered client ID.
winner: Gemini closer on API; both missed native MCP at api.grain.com/_/mcp
evidence_notes: Authentication docs state personal-scope tokens (PATs) authenticate Grain MCP at api.grain.com/_/mcp. Workspace-scope tokens not accepted by MCP.

name: Otter.ai
auth_type: Bearer API Token (Public API) / OAuth with granular permissions (MCP)
credential_access: Public API: Enterprise plan required (Integrations → Developer, max 2 keys). MCP: OAuth-authenticated setup for Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor.
verified_verdict: Feasible with Gating (API is Enterprise; MCP available)
winner: Perplexity correct on API enterprise gate; both missed official Otter MCP server
evidence_notes: Official Otter Help Center confirms Otter MCP Server with OAuth access. Public REST API requires Enterprise contract.

name: PitchBook
auth_type: API Key / Auth Token (Direct Data API); Okta OAuth (MCP Gateway)
credential_access: REST API: Request access through PitchBook Direct Data team (standalone agreement). MCP Gateway: Okta OAuth login.
verified_verdict: Feasible with Gating (Direct Data sales contract / Okta MCP Gateway)
winner: Perplexity correct on gating (Gemini missed sales requirement); both missed Okta MCP gateway
evidence_notes: PitchBook MCP Gateway provides Okta OAuth login (mcp-proxy-external.pitchbook.com). REST API requires Direct Data sales agreement.

name: WhatsApp Business
auth_type: OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token (Temporary in API Setup; Permanent via System User)
credential_access: Sandbox: instant test token in Meta App. Production: Meta Business Verification + System User with business_management & whatsapp_business_messaging.
winner: Perplexity correct on production gating; Meta official agentic tools MCP endpoint active
evidence_notes: Cloud API get-started docs confirm permanent token requires System User. Meta agentic-tools GitHub documents WhatsApp Business Tools MCP at mcp.facebook.com.

name: Google Ads
auth_type: Application Default Credentials (ADC) / OAuth 2.0 (stdio or Cloud Run Streamable HTTP)
credential_access: Google Cloud project with Google Ads API enabled. Test Access: instant. Production: requires project approval. Google sunset developer tokens Sept 9, 2026.
verified_verdict: Feasible with Gating (Cloud Project Access Tier & Official MCP)
winner: Both AI outdated on auth (both cited sunset developer tokens; missed official google-ads-mcp)
evidence_notes: Official Google Ads Developer guide confirms official 'google-ads-mcp' package (pipx run google-ads-mcp) via stdio/Cloud Run. Google officially sunset developer tokens on Sept 9, 2026 in favor of Cloud Project access tiers.

name: Notion
auth_type: Bearer Token (Internal Connection Token, Personal Access Token, or OAuth 2.0)
credential_access: Self-serve free in Developer portal (app.notion.com/developers/connections). Internal connections require workspace owner; PATs user-scoped.
winner: Gemini correct on official MCP (Notion officially launched remote MCP at mcp.notion.com/mcp)
evidence_notes: Official Notion developer guide explicitly documents Notion MCP for Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini with remote endpoint mcp.notion.com/mcp.

name: Stripe
auth_type: Secret Bearer Key (sk_live / sk_test), Restricted API Keys, or OAuth 2.0
credential_access: Instant self-serve in Stripe Dashboard (Developers → API keys). Test mode keys generated with zero friction.
winner: Gemini correct on official MCP (Stripe officially released remote MCP server at mcp.stripe.com)
evidence_notes: Official documentation at docs.stripe.com/mcp details remote endpoint mcp.stripe.com, setup via stripe agent setup, and granular read/write toolsets.

name: Slack
credential_access: Instant self-serve via api.slack.com/apps; Slack MCP server natively enabled in Slack workspace / Enterprise org.
winner: Both AI accurate on core API; human verification confirmed native Slack MCP Server & Slackbot MCP Client
evidence_notes: Official Slack guide ('Guide to MCP in Slack' & docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server) confirms Slack provides both official MCP Server (for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) and Slackbot MCP Client.
